tutorials.title: Multiworld Setup Guide
tutorials.description: A guide to setting up Return of the Obra Dinn for MultiWorld.
tutorials.text:
# Return of the Obra Dinn Archipelago Setup Guide

## Required Software

- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest)
- [Return of the Obra Dinn APWorld](https://gitlab.com/obra-dinn-archipelago/world)
- [Return of the Obra Dinn Mod](https://gitlab.com/obra-dinn-archipelago/mod)
- [PC Copy of Return of the Obra Dinn](https://obradinn.com/)
- [BepInEx v5.*](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases)

## Setup

1. Download the APWorld and add it to your Archipelago 'custom_worlds' folder.
2. In the Archipelago Launcher, click on the button that says "Generate Template Options". Then click on the button that
   says "Browse Files", which should open a file explorer window. Navigate to your "Players" folder, then the "
   Templates" folder. There should be a 'Return of the Obra Dinn.yaml' file there, which you can then copy and edit to
   meet your generation needs.
3. [Install BepInEx.](https://docs.bepinex.dev/articles/user_guide/installation/index.html#installing-bepinex) *Note: If
   on Windows, use the x86 version.* **Don't forget to launch the game once and then close it before proceeding to the
   following steps**
4. Download and unzip the latest mod release to the bepinex 'plugins' folder.
5. Once your session has been generated and is available for connections, launch the 'Obra Dinn Client' in the
   Archipelago Launcher and connect to your server.
6. Once the client is connected, launch Obra Dinn and click 'Start'. The game should automatically connect to the
   server. Good luck!

## Helpful Notes
- Pressing 'C' will resend your completed checks if there is ever a desync between your game and the server.
